name: sandbox_after_refusal
description: C1 defect (2 of 13 runs): the cache-path RI fit REFUSES (true n = 1.2 is outside [1.5, 3.0]), so the model retries around the guardrail through sandbox_fit_archie with model-supplied arrays. The sandbox clamps the out-of-range free fit to the bound (n = 1.500, corrected = True) and used to render 'RI Archie n=1.500' as if fitted; the model then reports n = 1.500 as 'the fitted exponent'. The plot label must say 'not fitted' with metadata.archie.n = null, and the citation gate must strip the prose 1.500 because the sandbox is not a cache-backed fitter.

assistant.text: The cache fit refused; fitting the RI data directly instead.
